targetWords.definition: A band is a group of people who play music.
targetWords.example: My brother is in a rock band.

targetWords.definition: Barely means by the smallest amount, almost not.
targetWords.example: I barely had enough money to pay for my bus ticket.

targetWords.definition: If something is boring, it is not fun.
targetWords.example: I think the Internet is boring.

targetWords.definition: To cancel means to decide that an event or a request will not happen.
targetWords.example: She cancelled the rest of her plans because of the rain.

targetWords.definition: A driveway is a short private road that leads to a person's home. — The long driveway led us to their new house.
Garbage is waste material like unwanted or spoiled food, bottles, paper, etc.
targetWords.example: The boy cleaned up the garbage around his house.

targetWords.definition: An instrument is something designed to do a certain task like music.
targetWords.example: ■My favorite musical instrument is the piano.

targetWords.definition: A list is a record of information printed with an item on each line.
targetWords.example: My mom makes a list ofgroceries to buy.

targetWords.definition: Magic is the power to do impossible things.
targetWords.example: •The magician used magic to pull a rabbit out of his hat.

targetWords.definition: A message is a set of words that you send to someone.
targetWords.example: I left a message for you in the envelope.

targetWords.definition: To notice something is to see it for the first time.
That thing belongs to you.
To predict something is to say that it will happen.
targetWords.example: She predicted that I would get married next year.

targetWords.definition: A professor is a person who teaches in college.
targetWords.example: Mike's science professor knows a lot about physics.

targetWords.definition: To rush is to go somewhere or do something very quickly.
A schedule is a plan that tells you when to do things.
targetWords.example: What is your class schedule for today?

targetWords.definition: To share something is to give some of it to another person.
A stage is a place where actors or musicians act or sing.
targetWords.example: A large screen was on the stage.

targetWords.definition: There is a lot of rain or snow.
targetWords.example: Did that storm wake you up last night?

targetWords.definition: — Within the box, there was a pizza.

story.title: The Party
story.passage:
Cody's family moved to a new house. His dad got a new job as a professor.

Cody liked his new town, but he missed his grandparents. For his birthday, Cody

wanted to have a party. His dad said, "Yes, we could even have a band play!"

On the day of the party, Cody woke up and rushed to get ready. He started to

check his list of things to do. He was so excited! But then he noticed something

terrible. There was snow on the ground and lots of it! " Dad!" he yelled. " How can

the band play their instruments outside?"

Dad said, "We'll move the stage inside." It barely fit within the garage because

there were some boxes and garbage there. But when they finished, they got a call

from the band. They did not want to come in the snow storm.

Dad said, " Let's get someone to perform magic." But no one would come

because of the snow.

Finally, Dad said, " Cody, there's too much snow. We need to cancel the party."

"Yes, sir," Cody said sadly. " It's going to be a boring birthday," he predicted.

Cody wanted to share his birthday with someone. He wanted to be at his old

home. He wanted to see his grandparents.

But then something got his attention. He noticed a car in the driveway. His

grandparents owned a car like that!

Cody was right. His

grandparents came for his

birthday! " Happy birthday, Cody!

We're sorry we are late. But there

was so much snow. It made us

go off schedule. We tried to leave

a message to tell you."

Cody told them what

happened. " I'm sorry," said

Grandpa.

" I was sad," Cody said. " But

I'm not anymore. I'm so happy to

see you." Dad brought out Cody's

birthday treat. It was his favorite

i

type, a sundae with whipped

cream on top. Then Cody told

his grandparents about the new

town. It was his best birthday

ever.
